title: Cookies
intro: This website doesn't use advertising or tracking cookies.
body:
*Last updated: [date]*

## What we use

We don't use cookies to track you, to show you adverts or to measure how you use the website.

This website doesn't set any cookies of its own, so there's nothing to accept or decline.

## Other websites

When you follow a link to Amazon or another shop, that website's own cookie policy applies.

## If this changes

If we ever add analytics or other cookies that aren't strictly necessary, we'll update this page and ask for your consent before setting them, as UK law requires.

---

*This policy describes the website as it was built. If you add analytics, embedded videos, social media widgets or a newsletter sign-up that loads code from another company, this page will need updating and you may need a cookie consent banner. Please have it reviewed before launch.*
